origins.planned_query: Fix three confirmed defects in Coin's internal SbHash<Key,Type> chained hash table (broken const-only iterator, a self-assignment that clears the source before copying it, and a resize that is not exception-safe and leaks live objects when a key/value copy throws mid-rehash) and decide whether resize should relink existing nodes instead of copying them, informed by how mature hash table implementations handle the same problems.
